info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Ratings-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Ratings API enables users to retrieve and analyze ratings for rideshare services. This endpoint provides access to aggregated feedback on rides, essential for optimizing service quality and enhancing user experience. Typical consumers include rideshare operators and developers looking to integrate rating analytics into their platforms. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can assess customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement based on comprehensive ride rating data.

get.summary: Fetch the rating for a specific ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the rating associated with a specific ride, providing insights into rider satisfaction and overall experience.
